title: Baseball
text:
Welcome! This site explores the history of Major League Baseball through its data, using the Lahman database.
The Lahman database provides historical records on players, teams, batting, pitching, and awards dating back to 1871. Through data visualization and statistical summaries, we examine long-term trends and milestones across more than a century of professional baseball.
